# DESIGN ROUTE / IMPLEMENTATION MATRIX — FIT-001 … FIT-110

**Phase 3 deliverable.** Generated by parsing `manifest.json` (110 screens) against
`apps/mobile/lib/core/router/app_router.dart` (91 `GoRoute` declarations), resolving each
route's builder widget to its defining file. No file was modified to produce this.

Package: authoritative `fitness-handoff/` — see `DESIGN_INTAKE_REPORT.md`.
Repository: branch `chore/qa-environments-secure-ai-backend` @ `5b9ac79`.

---

## 1 · Headline result

| Measure | Value |
|---|---|
| FIT screens | 110 |
| **Mapped to an existing repo route** | **105** |
| No route (4 non-route entries + 1 sub-state) | 5 |
| Implementing file resolved | 105 |
| Behind `PaywallGate` | 22 |
| Locked anchors (`manifest.locked`) | 29 |
| Distinct repo routes touched | 50 |
| Distinct implementing files touched | 45 |

**Every design route already exists in the application.** Integration is therefore a
*replacement of existing implementations*, not the construction of 110 new screens.
That materially changes the shape of the work and is the single most important finding
of Phase 3.

### Waves

| Wave | Screens |
|---|---|
| Approved core | 33 |
| Wave 1 | 31 |
| Wave 2 | 24 |
| Wave 3 | 13 |
| Wave 4 | 9 |
